name: print-social-cream-events-schedule-poster-with-pastel-colour-bars
title: Cream 'Events Schedule September' poster with lime tilted label and pastel colour-coded bars
whatItIs: A portrait cream poster with a heavy black 'EVENTS SCHEDULE SEPTEMBER' headline, a tilted lime '2026' sticker, arrow buttons and a month switcher, and five rounded rows pairing a white date cell (01 SUN) with a pastel mint, pink, lime or blue title bar.
whatItMeans: Friendly and organised; pastel coding makes each event distinct at a glance.
techniques: Tilt a small sticker label across the headline.
Split each row into a date cell and title bar.
Mimic UI controls like arrows and month tabs.

vocabulary.definition: A small tilted tag layered on type.
